extracted.intended_audience: USPTO stakeholders, patent/trademark analysts, policymakers, and IP practitioners interested in USPTO workload and performance statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and interpret USPTO performance and workload statistics (patent and trademark issuance, reexamination/supplemental metrics, PTAB case counts, trademark processing and contested-case statistics, petitions actions, and related footnote guidance) from the FY2021 Performance and Accountability Report tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of Utility Patents Issued to Micro, Small, and Large Entities (FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage breakdown of utility patents issued by entity size (micro, small, large) with separate columns for U.S. origin and foreign origin, reported by Year of Grant (FY2017–FY2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 1) Patent origin is based on residence of the first-named inventor. 2) FY2021 filing data is preliminary and will be finalized in the FY2022 PAR. Prior years may have been updated with final end-of-year numbers. Note: Past years' data may have been revised to reflect patent withdrawal information updated during the year; withdrawal status of patents issued in prior years may change.

rubrics_metrics.name: United States Government Agency Patents (FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility patents assigned to U.S. government agencies/departments at time of patent issue, reported by agency/department and year (FY2017–FY2021) with totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: Data represent utility patents assigned to agencies at time of issue and are subject to minor revisions. Past years’ data may have been revised to reflect patent withdrawal information updated during the year. 'No agency or department listed in database' and special-notes (e.g., 'Not previously reported') are indicated where applicable. '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex Parte Reexamination Activity (Table 13A, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of ex parte reexamination activity: Requests Filed (total, by patent owner, by third party, commissioner ordered), Determinations on Requests (total), Requests Granted (by examiner, by petition), Requests Denied, Requests Known to Have Related Litigation, and Filings by Discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: '*' Only represents requests that have received a filing date. Litigation search numbers were updated to include old pending reexaminations that ultimately require new litigation. Filings were updated to include reexams that had not been granted a filing date or had a filing date vacated in FY20. '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Examination Activity (Table 13B, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts for supplemental examinations: Supplemental Examinations Filed (total), Granted a Filing Date (total), Determinations on Supplemental Examinations Granted a Filing Date (total), Substantial New Question Found, Substantial New Question Not Found, Requests Known to Have Related Litigation, and Filings by Discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: '*' Late-filed requests may not have had a determination by the end of the fiscal year; numbers will be revised in the following year’s PAR where necessary. Filings were updated to include supplemental examinations that had not been granted filing dates or had their filing dates vacated in FY2020. Litigation search numbers were updated to include old pending reexaminations that ultimately require new litigation. '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Cases Before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (Table 14, as of Sept 30, 2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and flows for PTAB case categories (Ex Parte Appeals, Ex Parte and Reissue Appeals, Reexamination Appeals — ex parte and inter partes, Supplemental Examination Appeals, Interferences, AIA Trials including Inter Partes Reviews, TPCBM Proceedings, Post Grant Reviews, Derivation Proceedings): Cases Pending at start of FY, Cases Filed during FY, Cases Disposed during FY, Total Pending as of 9/30/2021, and related rehearings/pendency breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: '—   Represents zero.' and '* Changes in end-of-FY 2020 data due to internal FY2021 audit.' Table includes additional subcounts for reinstatements/rehearings and notes where data were adjusted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Trademark Examining Activities (Table 15, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple trademark operational metrics reported annually: Applications for Registration (including additional classes) and Applications Filed; Disposal of Trademark Applications (Registrations including classes, Abandonments including classes); Trademark First Actions (including additional classes); Applications Approved for Publication; Certificates of Registration Issued (1946 Act Principal Register, Intent-to-Use Statements of Use Registered, 1946 Act Supplemental Register); Total Certificates of Registration; Renewal of Registration metrics (Section 9 applications filed; Section 8 applications filed; Registrations renewed); Affidavits Sec.8/15 Filed and Disposed; Amendments to Allege Use Filed; Statements of Use Filed; Notices of Allowance Issued; Total Active Certificates of Registration; Pendency—Average number of months between filing and examiner’s first action and between filing and registration/abandonment/NOAs (including/excluding suspended and inter partes proceedings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 'Applications filed' counts include additional classes (workload counted per class) except for certain items noted (Certificates of Registration, Renewals, and Affidavits under Sec 8/15 and 12(c)). Renewal of Registration timing note: required beginning 10 years following registration (concurrent with 20-year renewals coming due). Since Trademark Law Treaty implementation (FY2000) a Section 8 Affidavit is required for filing a renewal. '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark Applications Filed for Registration and Renewal and Trademark Affidavits Filed (Table 16, FY2001–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-series counts (FY2001–FY2021) of trademark filings by year: For Registration, For Renewal, and Section 8 Affidavit filings (annual totals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnote: Renewal of registration term changed in November 16, 1989 (FY1990) with implementation of the Trademark Law Reform Act. The table shows long-term trends and includes extra-class counts where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Pending Trademark Applications (Table 17, FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Snapshot counts of pending trademark application files and classes by stage of processing: Pending Applications (total); In Preexamination Processing; Under Examination (total) with breakdowns for Applications Under Initial Examination (amended awaiting action by examiner; awaiting first action), Intent-to-Use Applications Pending Use; Applications Under Second Examination (administrative processing of statements of use; undergoing second examination; amended awaiting action by examiner); Other Pending Applications; In Postexamination Processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 'Includes applications pending before the Trademark Trial and Appeal Board and suspended cases.' and 'Includes all applications in all phases of publication, issue, and registration.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks Registered, Renewed, and Published Under Section 12(c) (Table 18, FY2001–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts (FY2001–FY2021) of Certificates of Registration issued, Renewals, and Registrations (including classes), showing time-series totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 'Includes withdrawn numbers.' and notes on renewal-term change in FY1990 that affected counts (10-year vs 20-year renewal term change).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark Applications Filed by Residents of the United States (Table 19, FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of trademark applications filed in FY2021 by U.S. state/territory of residence (total filings and per-state/territory breakdown).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 'Represents residents of American Samoa, Guam, and miscellaneous U.S. Pacific Islands.' and 'No State indicated in database (includes Army Post Office filings)' where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks Registered to Residents of the United States (Table 20, FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of trademarks registered in FY2021 by U.S. state/territory of the registrant (total certificates and per-state/territory breakdown).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: When a trademark is registered, the database is updated with the registrant's home state. Notes indicate representation of U.S. Pacific Islands and unspecified/state-missing records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark Applications Filed by Residents of Foreign Countries and Territories (Table 21, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-series counts (FY2017–FY2021) of trademark applications filed by residents of foreign countries and territories, broken out by country/territory and year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: Large table; 'Country of origin information not available or not indicated in database (includes African Regional Intellectual Property Organization filings)' is indicated where applicable. '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks Registered to Residents of Foreign Countries and Territories (Table 22, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-series counts (FY2017–FY2021) of trademarks registered to residents of foreign countries and territories, broken out by country/territory and year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes similar to Table 21: country-origin missing notation for certain entries; '-   Represents zero.' The table includes cumulative and per-country registration counts and notes on data updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Contested Trademark Cases (Table 23, within USPTO, as of Sept 30, 2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for contested trademark case categories handled within the USPTO: Oppositions, Ex Parte Activity, Cancellations, Concurrent Use, Interference, and Totals with metrics for Cases Pending as of 9/30/2020, Cases Filed during FY2021, Disposals during FY2021 (with breakdowns: Before Oral Hearing or Briefing; After Briefing (No Oral Hearing); After Oral Hearing), and Cases Pending as of 9/30/2021 (Awaiting Decision; In Process before Hearing or Final Briefing). Also includes Requests Made for Extension of Time to Oppose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: 'Includes suspended cases.' and '-   Represents zero.' The table reports disposals and pending case workflow measures and includes notes where categories were counted separately (e.g., petitions under rules 2.66 and 2.146).

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions on Petitions to the Director — Patent Matters (Table 24, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of actions on patent-related petitions to the Director, by petition nature: Actions on Patent Petitions (total), Acceptance of Late Assignments, Late Issue Fees, Late Priority Papers, Access, Certificates of Correction, Deferment of Issue, Entity Status Change, Filing Date matters, Maintenance Fees, Revivals, Rule 47 (37 CFR 1.47), Supervisory Authority, Suspend Rules, Withdrawal from Issue, Withdraw Holding of Abandonment, Late Benefit or Priority Claim, Withdraw as Attorney, Matters Not Provided For (37 CFR 1.182), To Make Special, Patent Term Adjustment/Extension, and other categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: Annual totals and category breakdowns are shown; table notes changes and provides totals. The table shows both counts and trend changes; '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions on Petitions to the Director — Trademark Matters (Table 24, FY2017–FY2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of actions on trademark-related petitions to the Director: Actions on Trademark Petitions (total), Filing Date Restorations, Inadvertently Issued Registrations, Letters of Protest, Madrid Petitions, Make Special, Reinstatements, Revivals (reviewed on paper / granted electronically), Waived Fees and Refunds, Miscellaneous Petitions, Board Matters, Post Registration Matters (Post Publication Amendments), Petitions Awaiting Action as of 9/30/2020, and subcategories of Trademark Petitions Awaiting Response (e.g., petitions under rules 2.66 and 2.146) and Trademark Petitions to Revive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes: Explanatory notes on what 'Applications filed' and restoration/revival categories mean; the petition-to-director counts include certain categories separated in earlier years; '-   Represents zero.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Cases in Litigation (Selected U.S. Courts) — (Table 25 beginning)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of litigation matters involving USPTO-related cases in selected U.S. courts (e.g., U.S. District Courts civil actions): Cases Pending as of 9/30/2020, Cases Filed during FY2021, and related litigation flow counts (table begins in this chunk and continues beyond).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chunk contains the start of Table 25; full definitions and complete counts are in the follow-on pages. Use caution: table is truncated in this chunk; consult full report for complete litigation metrics.
